title: 8 Claude Code agents running experiments on each other
description: I have 8 Claude Code agents running 24/7, all chatting with each other and running experiments on themselves. The system is cortextOS. Every agent has a comms channel with every other agent, and they self-evolve using an auto-research cycle that rewrites their own skill and behavior files. I even gave them a theta wave feature that mimics human sleep: two agents go adversarial overnight, audit the whole codebase and each others work, and find the gaps to fix in the next cycle. This completely changed how I run my business. The whole thing plus install instructions is hosted in my community, and its open to contributions. Link in bio.
